name: itsdangerous
setup: PY=$(command -v python3.13 || command -v python3.12 || command -v python3.11 || command -v python3.10 || echo python3) && rm -rf .venv && $PY -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip -q install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip -q install -e . pytest freezegun
